disclosureQuote: As an independent team with limited resources, we used generative AI tools to create the presenter in the narrative opening video and a limited number of voice lines in the game. No generative AI technology was used in any other part of the game's playable content, art assets, or code.
summary: 抢先体验的 roguelike 动作冒险。开发者以“独立团队资源有限”为由，披露 AI 用于叙事开场视频的主持人与游戏内少量语音台词，并声明可玩内容、美术素材与代码的其他部分均未使用生成式 AI。
reviewNote: 核查 Steam 英文商店页完整 AI 披露、身份（开发商 ChillyRoom, CritTeam 暴击组）与英文讨论区首页（可见 15 个主题，总数 285），首页没有与 AI 使用直接相关的主题，未逐帖展开。本款单独检索公开报道 1 次、登记 6 条结果，读取 1 篇原始来源（Steam 社区玩家在讨论区指称本作用到生成式 AI 语音、且称页面当时无披露（与当前商店披露不一致，属玩家指控））。领域判定全部来自商店披露原文，结论基于开发者自述，未经独立审计。 本作处于抢先体验阶段。 检索到的社区帖指称本作用到未披露的 AI 语音，与当前商店披露相互矛盾；按规则只登记不判定，不作为任何领域的证据。
description: 官方披露把 AI 限定在开场视频主持人与少量语音，其余可玩内容、美术与代码声明未使用。

english.summary: An Early Access roguelike action adventure. Calling itself a resource-limited independent team, the developer states generative AI was used to create the presenter in the narrative opening video and a limited number of voice lines, and that no generative AI was used in any other part of the playable content, art assets or code.
english.reviewNote: Reviewed the full English Steam AI disclosure, the identity (developer ChillyRoom, CritTeam) and the English discussion homepage (15 visible topics of 285); no homepage topic directly concerns AI use and individual threads were not opened. This title was searched 1 time with 6 results and 1 raw source(s) were read. Every area finding comes from the store disclosure text itself and rests on the developer's own statement, without an independent audit. The game is in Early Access. A community thread alleging undisclosed AI voice-over was read and logged as an allegation only; it is not evidence and changes no area finding.
